{"action":"done","summary":"All 4 public acceptance tests pass. The BatchWriter implementation in tinydb/journal.py correctly implements all requirements R01-R08:

- R01: apply(operations) accepts insert/remove operations, returns inserted IDs
- R02: Atomic batch with rollback on error via _simulate then write pattern
- R03: No aliasing via deepcopy; ordinary TinyDB operations work normally
- R04: bool rejected as doc_id (type check), structural validation on operations
- R05: preview(operations) returns IDs without committing, doesn't consume IDs
- R06: Fresh snapshot read from storage each call (no stale cache)
- R07: Idempotency token support - identical batch/token returns cached result, different ops raise ValueError
- R08: Token bookkeeping stored in BatchWriter's self.tokens dict, never in user documents

No changes were needed - the existing implementation already satisfies all requirements."}
